services.name: Heads Up Fly Fishing
services.desc: Traveling to fish connects us to nature, to like minded people, and to something far beyond the water itself. The fly rod becomes a passport, the guide a storyteller, and every journey a new chapter in the same story the pursuit of what’s wild and beautiful. Each of these destinations offers a different way to explore click below to begin your story. Shallow flats, winding backcountry, and endless mangroves make the Everglades one of the most dynamic fisheries in North America. We put our focus in the big three, tarpon, redfish, and snook. services.name: Horse Back Trips
services.desc: Come join us for horseback fly fishing trips in Colorado’s Weminuche Wilderness, a federally protected area accessible only by foot or horseback. We offer day trips as well as 3 and 5-day all inclusive packages out of our comfortable base camp. Ride out of camp every day to fish the numerous streams and lakes of this pristine ecosystem surrounded by the impressive peaks of the San Juan Mountains.
